question: The best passive form of the sentence "The pill teste bitter" is:
options: The pill is bitter when it is tasted.

correct_answer: The pill is bitter when it is tasted.
explanation:
🔖Quasi-passive voice: Complement যুক্ত Active কে Passive এ রূপান্তর
count, feel, look, sell, smell taste, read, sound, write ইত্যাদি Quasi-passive verb গুলোর পরে Complement থাকলে এদের passive voice নিম্নরূপে হয়ে থাকে। I
Active : Subject + Quasi-passive verb + complement (adjective)
Passive : Subject অপরিবর্তিত + is/was + complement + when it/ is/was/ +V3
তবে Subject টি plural হলে is/was এর স্থলে are/were এবং it এর স্থলে they হবে।
subject: English Language and Literature

question: The indirect form of the sentence"Farida said to her mother, " I shall go to bed now."" is
options: Farida told her mother that she should go ot bed now
Farida told her mother that she will go to bed then
Farida told mother that she would go to bed then.
Farida told her mother that she will go to bed now
correct_answer: Farida told mother that she would go to bed then.
explanation:
🔖Reporting verb টি past tense এর হওয়ায় Reported speech এ Indirect narration এ ক্ষেত্রে shall এর হলে 'would' ব্যবহৃত হয়। Reported speech-এ first person থাকলে reporting verb-এর sub অনুযায়ী পরিবর্তিত হবে আর Future Indefinite-এ থাকলে তা future past এবং now, then-এ রূপান্তরিত হবে।
Farida said to her mother, "I shall go to bed now"---- বাক্যটির indirect speech হবে-- Farida told her mother that she would go to bed then.
subject: English Language and Literature

question: If a mechant offers a discount of 30% on the price, then he/she makes a loss 16% percentage of profit of loss will the merchant make if sell at a discount of 10% the list price?
explanation:
🔖Let, the cost price be Tk. X
So, the selling price be Tk. \( (x-\frac{16x}{100}) \) = Tk \( \frac{21x}{25} \)
At 30% discount,
If selling price Tk. 70 then list price Tk. 100
so " " " \( \frac{21x}{25} \) then list price tk \( \frac{21x\times 100}{25\times 70} \) = Tk \( \frac{6x}{5} \)
Again, at 10% discount,
If list price Tk. 100 then selling price Tk. 90
so " " " \( \frac{6x}{5} \) then selling price tk \( \frac{90\times 6x}{100\times 5} \) = Tk \( \frac{27x}{25} \)
So, profit will be Tk \( (\frac{27x}{25}-x) \) = Tk \( \frac{2x}{25} \)
So, profit percent \( (\frac{2x}{25}÷x\times 100)\% \) = 8%
